title: Prepare-draft decision record (private, local JSON)
description: Smallest structured private decision record binding human approvals to a stable execution fingerprint. The fingerprint binds plan identity PLUS packaged statement/biography text, artwork title/year/medium, and processing.untagged_colour_policy. Acknowledgements authorize prepare action but MUST NOT invent organiser facts, force-pass mismatches, invent upload limits, or rewrite knowledge_status to unsupported not_required.

fictional_test_record.description: Mark clearly fictional decision files used by synthetic tests.

plan_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of canonical execution identity: material plan + packaged statement/bio + artwork title/year/medium + processing.untagged_colour_policy (see docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md). Volatile timestamps are excluded.

processing.description: Material processing decisions bound into the execution fingerprint. Changing untagged_colour_policy invalidates execute approval.

untagged_colour_policy.description: Explicit decision for untagged RGB/L sources. null only when no untagged sources exist.

authorizes_prepare_only.description: When true, acknowledgement only authorizes running prepare-draft; it is not organiser evidence.

approved_at.description: Optional wall-clock stamp; NOT part of the plan fingerprint.
